subject: schema-invalid.json
why: An unknown field (`swapRick`, a typo for `swapRisk`) — additionalProperties is false, so a typo fails loudly instead of being silently ignored.

subject: owner-unknown.json
why: `owner.project` is not a project key in plan.json. The agent is an enum in the schema; the project list moves, so the validator owns it.

subject: requires-unresolved.json
why: A non-optional requirement no module in the workspace provides.

subject: requires-range-mismatch.json
why: collab provides `@paperos/contract-collab` 0.1.0; this module asks for ^0.2.0. Pre-1.0, a minor bump is breaking.

subject: depends-on-disagrees.json
why: `dependsOn` says data-layer, `requires` derives identity. dependsOn is derived, never authored against the grain.

subject: slot-unknown.json
why: A fill targeting `shell.nope`, which no module exposes.

subject: topic-undeclared.json
why: The module publishes a topic its own contract package does not declare. Checked only when the contract package resolved.

subject: duplicate-provider.json
why: A second module providing `@paperos/contract-tables` under the same `impl`. Two implementations are fine; two with the same name are not.

subject: provides-version-mismatch.json
why: The manifest declares contract 0.2.0 while the contract package is at 0.1.0.

subject: cycle-a.json
why: Two modules that require each other non-optionally. The message names the whole path.
